artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the hull is legible but exhibits slight warping and irregular character spacing typical of AI generation. The letters do not sit perfectly flat against the curved surface of the hull, showing minor floating artifacts.
The water texture is somewhat repetitive and painterly. The wake behind the boat lacks the complex turbulent structure of real water displacement, appearing more like a smoothed gradient.
The base of the white water cannon on the bow appears to merge slightly with the deck railing without a clear mechanical mounting point or bolts, suggesting a minor fusion artifact.
